definition: unordered sets of distinct 8-bit masks; Hamming distance = popcount(a XOR b)

three_ones_distance_at_least_three.proof: Equal weights give even distances. Each position can occur in at most 3 masks; 3*M <= 8*3.

balanced_construction.method: Nonconstant affine functions on three input bits

four_ones_distance_four.proof: Each position occurs in at most 7 masks, so 4*M <= 8*7.

mixed_two_four_six_ones_distance_four.proof: Puncture one position: a length-7 distance-3 code. Disjoint radius-1 balls give M*8 <= 128.
mixed_two_four_six_ones_distance_four.tradeoff: Changes mask density; selected/complement portions are no longer always equal.

three_ones_distance_two.tradeoff: Permits pairs differing in only two bit positions.
